about: The exhilarating yokai action game is back with brand new controls.
Jajamaru and his friends are going to face off against the largest yokai army in history!
More than 20 different characters are available, which includes familiar yokai's from the series along with characters from the Jajamaru family with new action.
The game can be played by two players sharing a single screen.
Online ranking for high scores are supported.
The basic controls are move, attack and jump.
The stage is cleared when all the yokai are defeated.
The player and the enemy each have their own health gauges and if the player's energy gauge runs out, it's game over.
If you break a scaffold in the stage, you will be able to get an "invisible pill" and a "Minecart ".
In addition, gold blocks will reveal three types of items that can be used to activate ninjutsu.
summary: The exhilarating yokai action game is back with brand new controls.
